slides.title: Face to face
body: The Moon is full in Taurus, facing the king (the Sun) in Scorpio. Grahas face to face act on each other directly, so the mind and the self meet in full light.

body: On Monday night at about 9 PM the mother (the Moon) walks into Taurus, where she is exalted.
slides.closing: Good for hosting, giving and talking things through
